summary: not our words Like Flower Moon before Legends of conquered Live on in tales of New England farmers while Genocide broke many a Lodge words hang a Wigwam frame abandoned but holding up our soul to Forgiveness #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
not our words
Like Flower Moon
before
Legends of conquered
Live on in tales of
    New England farmers
while Genocide broke
many a Lodge
words hang
a Wigwam frame
abandoned but
holding up our soul to
Forgiveness
#smallpoems
